name: colliedesk
description: Work your Colliedesk inbox from Codex and ChatGPT: the Colliedesk MCP server and skills to triage, draft replies, chase pending conversations and set up channels.

interface.longDescription: Colliedesk is an open-source helpdesk for small support teams. This plugin connects your Colliedesk workspace and lets you work the inbox from a conversation: find and read customer conversations, triage what nobody owns (status, priority, assignee, tags), draft replies built on your saved replies and help articles for a person to check and send, chase customers who stopped answering, and set up the email channel. It signs in with OAuth: you choose the workspace and allow it in your browser, and it acts as you, with the permissions your roles give you in that workspace. It reaches Colliedesk Cloud (app.colliedesk.com); a self-hosted Colliedesk server is added as its own MCP server. It sends a reply to a customer only when you ask it to.
defaultPrompt: Triage the open Colliedesk conversations nobody owns.
Draft a reply to the oldest open conversation in Colliedesk.
Which Colliedesk conversations wait on a customer for more than 3 days?
